name: 10pines-c2-elevator
title: Elevator controller with states
description: An automatic elevator controller that reacts to button and sensor events (calls from floors, door closed/opened, cabin on floor, wait for people timed out) and reports whether it is idle or working, the cabin stopped/moving/waiting and the door opened/opening/closing/closed, signaling ElevatorEmergency when sensors are out of sync. The student must implement Elevator from scratch so the 25 given tests pass, using the State pattern instead of conditionals.
source: 10Pines-Capacitacion/C2 - Diseño Avanzado de Software con Objetos II

design.notes: Three orthogonal state variables (controller idle/working, cabin stopped/moving/waiting, door opened/opening/closing/closed) whose combination decides what each event does; the naive solution is a web of nested ifs on booleans, the intended one is three State hierarchies with double dispatch back to the elevator, plus deciding who performs the transitions.
